notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Changes:

Online Leaderboard Added
Steam Success Added
French language added
Curtains transitions added


Bug fixed:

 Fixed a bug where you could pause and unpause the game on the "Enter Your Name" screen resulting in an infinite game


Have fun!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Change Notes
notes.content:
Changes :

 There is less cowboys from level 1 to 3 due to the difficulty and the fact that sometimes you can't find the Cowboy.
 There is now the version number on the title screen
 The game switch from X.X to X.X.X (in terms of updates)


Bug fixed :

 The amount of time showed the wrong time you gained. It is now fixed.


Have fun !

notes.title: Version 1.1 Change Notes
notes.content:
Changes :
You can now write a name from 2 to 10 characters.


Bug fixed :
A white text will now appear instead of a red text after you wrote a two name character and will not appear in the end of the next game.


Have fun !
